messages:
maria: Heads-up team — planning a coordinated cut for v2.4.1 in tonight's change window at 22:00 UTC. Need API/runtime/console/router pinned and a short canary with a traffic cushion.

samir: Copy. Who owns the rollback criteria and who is on-call inbound?

maria: Runtime & API own rollback decisions. Samir you'll monitor, Jen & Oliver are on-call for runtime/console respectively. Deploybot: please apply pins and start canary according to the plan below.

jen: Noted. Runtime note: this build swaps kernel selector to new path; there's an automated fallback to quant-legacy if runtime detects perf regression. Call that out in release notes.

oliver: Console has release notes ready and a quick rollback toggle added to the UI. Link in internal page once pins are live.

deploybot: Deploy queued: services pinned -> api:v2.4.1, runtime:v2.4.1, console:v2.4.1, router:v2.4.1. Canary plan: initial 5% for 10m, step to 25% over 15m, hold 25% for 15m. Traffic cushion: reserve +2 GPU nodes for dedicated pool. Auto-rollback thresholds: 5xx rate >0.5% for 5m OR P95 increase >200ms vs baseline.

samir: I'll put temporary alerts: kv_cache_miss >3% over 5m, token_cost_anomaly (zscore>3) and p95_delta>200ms. If any trigger -> pause canary and call runtime owners.

console-oncall-bot: Canary dashboards deployed: canary_latency, canary_errors, kv_miss, token_cost. Alerts routed to #eng-oncall + #incidents.

maria: Ops checklist once at 25%: run `curl -sS https://api.internal/health | jq .` and `ssh runtime-01 -- sudo /opt/bin/check-kv-cache.sh`. If smoke passes, continue to full rollout per release notes.

jen: Quick clarification: the runtime fallback path will only engage for request latency regressions >150ms sustained for 2m. It will log an event tagged runtime:fallback so we can alert.

oliver: Change window rules: we have an extra +2h buffer after cut. If stable at +90m we unpin and mark release complete. If any critical alert before that, perform rollback. Rollback steps summarized: 1) hit `/internal/rollback?release=v2.4.1` 2) orchestrator unpin 3) scale down new kernel pools 4) notify channels and close the release loop.

samir: Starting monitoring now. I'll post status every 5 minutes during the canary, and tag owners on any threshold trips.

maria: Starting the canary now. deploybot, proceed. :rocket:

deploybot: Canary started at 1733333333. Canary dashboard: https://telemetry/internal/canary/1733333333. ETA to 25% ~20m. Pins applied. Good luck! :thumbsup:
